card.label: 墨黑 · 字阶与留白
card.lineage: 当代字体样张的信息层级
card.thesis: 让标题、正文和次要信息自己建立层级，图片直接落在深色工作面上。
card.viewport: 轻薄导航与工具区；三列大图、短标题；Inspector 用开阔字阶与属性行组织，几乎不依赖横线。
card.risk: 留白更多，单屏资料量比紧凑方案少；必须让可编辑字段仍然容易辨认。

raised.raise: 卡片标题和次要行保持一致基线。
预览尺寸保持稳定，混合内容不跳动。
键盘焦点足够清楚，不依赖微弱色差。
重复行间距遵循统一节奏。
尺寸和数值保持稳定对齐。

prompt:
Create one exceptional, fully legible high-fidelity desktop application UI direction comp for Locus, an Electron personal media and AI-model collection workspace. This is a NEW modern dark-only direction exploration, not approved production art. Previous concepts were REJECTED as dated WPF-like desktop software. Work from scratch; do not imitate old Microsoft desktop panel styling, beveled controls, framed sections, blue-grey slabs, command bars, nested cards or giant footers. All interface surfaces must be dark, regardless of the user's OS. Natural photos keep their original bright colors. Contemporary design craft, clear restrained product UI, no dramatic branding moodboard.
STRUCTURE AT 1440x900 LANDSCAPE, edge-to-edge app viewport with NO external browser/device mockup: one very slim 36px Locus title bar, 52px left icon navigation rail for 内容 / 标签 / 设置, then main media grid and a 310px right Inspector. A quiet 64px work header contains 内容 and inline 筛选, a refresh icon, plus a small text-icon 导入 action toward its right. Main region has six large preview images/items in three columns and two rows. Images should dominate the available width and height; 18-24px gutters, 4-8px media corner rounding, no enclosing card panels. Beneath each image is one readable filename then one smaller metadata line on the same continuous page ground; no separate tinted caption block. Selected landscape.png uses a fine 1.5px focus/selection outline and a very subtle filename treatment, NO vertical decorative stripe, checkmark box, floating selection badge, gradient or glow. Card actions not shown as button footers. One slender resize seam separates Inspector, no section boxed panels. Tiny bottom status text only. Show 示例内容 once discreetly. No fake table controls or new features.
SAMPLE CONTENT shared across all candidates: landscape.png alpine lake photo, street.jpg urban architecture, botanical.png botanical digital illustration, coast.mp4 coastal video still with small 00:24 duration, notes.txt clean typographic file preview, model.safetensors simple readable model file preview without fake charts. Synthetic sample data only, no commercial or factual claims. Don't add batch checkboxes, folders, favorites, rating, AI search, share, export, cloud, or analytics.
INSPECTOR: top tabs 概览 and 内容. Under them filename landscape.png as current subject heading, no repeated preview image. Label 类型 value PNG; label 尺寸 value 960 × 540; ordinary open groups 个人标签 with 风景 / 参考 / inline +; 备注 compact two-line editable note 已整理，待补充来源。; 组件 shows simple icon+label rows 文件 and 图像; 标识 shows 01a0fe11-0cb0-7617-a120-211752dfa779 wrapping safely with a local copy icon; 默认视图 value 图像 with quiet select affordance. No accordion chevrons on section headings. Compact controls must be visually editable; do not put a rectangle around every text/value. No large save/cancel bar, giant cards, per-property rules, duplicate toast/banner, storage/size/dates invented beyond sample. All ordinary metadata remains exposed. Use whitespace instead of divider lines. Main/secondary text must be readable, clear CJK sans-serif, sensible 14-15px body text at 1440px, not tiny blurry technical font. No serif, monospace as main font, all-caps labels, decorative borders, glassmorphism, drop shadows on panels, blue/purple wash, warm vintage tint, fake grain, strokes between every row.
OPERATE COMPS RULES (verbatim):
The comp is the product screen, in the direction's committed palette: its shell and navigation with a distinct area for each job and, where there is data, filters over what they scope and charts and tables with clear states. The world enters only through type, palette, density, and the one signature move; it never supplies the page's organisation, so a working screen never reads as a newspaper, a poster, or any other artifact of the world. Every control is a standard one the visitor already knows how to use, a web component on the web and the platform's native control in an app: buttons, tabs, inputs, selects, filters, tables with sortable headers, navigation that reads as navigation. Never a costume of the world's own interface: a terminal's function-key bar or command prompt, an instrument's bezel, ruled ledger paper standing in for a table. A comp an engineer could not build from the platform's standard components is a picture of the tool, not the tool. The finish bar is the best product in the category: an aligned grid, consistent spacing, a real type scale, and clear hierarchy. The signature move adds to a screen that is already that clean; it never stands in for it.
Prompt with the screen's real content: the product name, realistic data with plausible values and units, real labels, and one state worth seeing (an alert, a degraded service, an empty filter result), never placeholder tiles.
Comps two and three vary the product's organisation, never its world coverage: the navigation model (side rail, top bar, command-first), how the work areas divide the screen, which data leads, the density, and where the signature move sits. Each must be recognisably different from the first at thumbnail size; a variant only its prompt can tell apart adds no choice. A variant that adds world material, texture, or ornament goes further in the wrong direction; on a working screen, more world is a costume.
Self-check every render: with the name covered, does it read as a product of its category, could the visitor do the task from it, and is it at least as clean as the category standard and more distinctive than it? If it reads as an artifact of the world first, regenerate with the shell and the work areas named region by region and the world held to its four contributions.
These are sibling direction cards, not the later three-composition round. Shared task and functional regions are deliberate. User's dark-only and anti-retro constraints override every source's original materials.

CARD-SPECIFIC DIRECTION:
OPEN GRAPHITE: confidently quiet near-black #111214 media canvas, #191A1D Inspector and rail, #25272B real input wells only. Soft-white #F0F1F3 primary and #A4A8B1 readable secondary text; restrained desaturated ice-blue #9CB9EA for active/focus only. Distinctive move is open typography: 23px medium subject heading with strong whitespace around it, section labels 12-13px medium, content 14-15px. 30-34px property rows, 28px between logical groups; inspector almost no horizontal rules. No boxed surrounding header. A generous calm typography-first modern creative app that still visibly works.
